key.name: profiles
key.description: One entry per gateway: id, name, host, port (the gateway's port on that host), token and kind (local or remote). Each gateway keeps its own token. A remote host is reached through an SSH tunnel whose local port is picked automatically. Empty means "migrate from the 0.1.2 settings on next start".

key.name: tunnel-port
key.summary: Local end of the open SSH tunnel (read-only)
key.description: Written by the extension: the 127.0.0.1 port the active remote profile's tunnel listens on, 0 when no tunnel is open. Picked automatically and never equal to the remote port. Settings reads it to open the remote dashboard.

key.name: active-profile
key.description: The id of the profile the indicator is connected to. Unknown or empty falls back to the first profile.

key.name: endpoint
key.description: Read once to migrate a 0.1.2 setup to profiles; no longer used afterwards.

key.name: endpoints
key.description: Read once to migrate a 0.1.2 setup to profiles; no longer used afterwards.

key.name: token
key.description: Read once to migrate a 0.1.2 setup to profiles (it becomes the token of the then-active endpoint); no longer used afterwards.

key.name: browser
key.description: Desktop file id of the browser to open links with (e.g. firefox.desktop). Empty = system default handler.

key.name: max-sessions
key.description: How many recent sessions to list in the dropdown menu (1-10).

key.name: show-previews
key.description: Show a short preview of the last message under each session.

key.name: poll-interval
key.description: How often to poll /api/status when the WebSocket is unavailable.

key.name: channel
key.description: Gateway release channel to track: stable (recommended) or insider (early features). Changing this asks the gateway to switch channels; the move takes effect on the next update.
